title: Meet the cylinder
narration: Meet the cylinder. A flat top, a curved side, and a shadow on the table. Let's see how these become one convincing drawing.

title: 01 · Build the frame
narration: Start with the big structure. Compare the height and width, mark the centre, and lightly frame the top and bottom. These guides keep your cylinder balanced.

title: 02 · Shape the ellipses
narration: Now shape the ellipses. A circle seen at an angle looks like an oval. Keep both ends rounded, then connect the sides with straight lines.

title: 03 · Find light and shadow
narration: Notice where curve meets flat. The top reads as one plane. Across the curved side, the tone changes gradually. Find the shadow side before adding small details.

title: Move the light
narration: Watch the light move. The bright area travels around the curve, while the top changes as a whole. The cast shadow falls away from the light.

title: 04 · Build the tones
narration: Build your tones gradually. Keep the light side clean, soften the transition, and deepen the shadow band. Reflected light can gently lift the far edge, but it still belongs to the shadow.

title: 05 · Ground the form
narration: Keep the rim clear where the flat top meets the curve. Darken the contact at the base, and soften the cast shadow as it moves away. Now your cylinder feels solid.

title: Your turn
narration: That's the journey: structure, ellipses, light, and tone. You'll follow the teacher one step at a time. Get your pencils ready, and let's draw.
